Low rugged silhouette, clearly volcanic but LESS CONICAL: avoid a smooth symmetric cone, triangle or circular pedestal. Very simple stylized silhouette, three broad shading regions, minimum detail, large connected pixel clusters. Use the restrained warm earthy palette and clear brightness hierarchy of the reference buildings; reserve cream highlights for the focal point. Transparent background and transparent outer margins. No grass tile, scenery, text, cast shadow, blur, antialiasing or scattered single-pixel noise. Keep all edges and effects within this fixed 32x32 canvas.
